findings.message: The param tarefaId selects a task of tarefasParaAcao, but no member selected it and no query fetches one record. Added selectTarefasParaAcao(id | null) and the getter tarefasParaAcao, which returns the loaded row whose id is selectedTarefa. An id that is not in the loaded rows publishes client.selectionInvalid in listarTarefasParaAcaoError.
public selectTarefasParaAcao is not declared by the defs; the shared added it so the pages can drive the page (a draft, a setter, a selection or a filter state).
public tarefasParaAcao is not declared by the defs; the shared added it so the pages can drive the page (a draft, a setter, a selection or a filter state).
